GDD §10 DIFFICULTY CURVE — 1.4.0 changes (draft by P1; P10 folds this into docs/GDD.md §10; numbers re-measured by P1M)
===========================================================================================================================

Retitle: "§10. Difficulty curve (campaign levels 1–30 and beyond)".

THE CURVE KEEPS RISING (F12, LEVELS.curve.post / post.late; levelgen.curve(L) is the one curve)
- loopAfter is retired: the script cache key, the generator, the leak band, the prefetch, the boss rotation and the finale
  test all use the real level number. Geometry keeps its L30 caps (1,400 m, 14 gate events, 12 m/s, E_start 10).
- E_boss(L): 1.3.0's to L30 (600 from L20), +10 per level to 900 at L60, +5 per level to 1,500 at L180, flat after;
  data.eBossOf(L) === curve(L).eBoss on L1–300 (the validator enforces it). Wave population +0.15 per level past L30 (28 at
  L60), then +0.05 to 32 (L140); run-up +0.5 per level (45 at L60), then +0.1 to 50 (L110). Calibration 1.53 at L30, 1.75 at
  L60, 1.85 at L260; shop exponent profileExp 0.50 / 0.53 / 0.56 at L30 / L60 / L260. Leak bands 0.28–0.32 to L45, 0.29–0.33
  to L120, 0.30–0.34 to L180, 0.31–0.35 after. Endless keeps its own curve (bands read at most at L45).
- Replace "After L30 the campaign loops at L30 parameters" with the above.

THE TEACHING LADDER (PLAN D9 + amendment A14; one headline per level; validate-levels checks every rule)
- Brute waves L4 → L6 (solo introduction on L6). Triple gates L7 → L8. ×3 L6 → L11 and ÷3 L8 → L11, one lesson on L11
  (both features on two gates of that level). The Hulk Twins debut L17 → L16.
- Pickup NEW cards (index L−1 of PICKUP_SCHEDULE, null = none): shotgun 1, armor 2, minigun 3, sniper 5, medic 6, flamer 8,
  rocket 10, railgun 12 (A14: L11 keeps the ×3 / ÷3 lesson), laser 14, drone 15, magnet 16, booster 17, chip 20, APC 21.
  No pickup debut on a Horde level (L4, 9, 13, 19 …) or on L4 / L7 / L18. Each special's own unlock level equals its
  schedule level (the FIELD GUIDE's "MEET IT ON LEVEL n"). Endless keeps the 1.3.0 delivery order (LEVELS.endless.pickups).
- Before L11 the gate generator never makes a ÷3: where the gap rule (below) needs a ÷ lane under the pick, the ÷2 keeps its
  value and its ×1 rung moves past the full intake (still within what a full squad lands), else it becomes a −B lesser evil.
- Update the level table: L4 "— (HORDE in 1.4.0)", L6 "brute, medic", L7 "— (NIGHT)", L8 "triple gates, flamethrower",
  L9 "brute pairs (HORDE)", L10 "rocket; endless unlocks", L11 "×3 and ÷3 gates, runner packs", L12 "railgun", L13 "— (HORDE)",
  L15 "drone", L16 "Hulk Twins, magnet, crawler swarms" (boss Hulk Twins), L17 "booster" (boss Juggernaut), L20 "chip",
  L21 "APC".

GATES: STEERING MUST MATTER (F12 + 1.4.0)
- Gap rule: every lane but the design pick shrinks until its full-intake outcome is ≤ gap(L) × the pick's (0.60 at L3, 0.62 at
  L9, 0.64 from L20); all-red pairs get it from L3 except on L5.
- OG (D27, GATE_RULES.generation.openerGapShops ['expected', 'max']): the opener's gap is applied again at the start squads
  of the expected shop and of rank 10 (25), so a bigger start squad never finds a lane far above the pick at gate 1 (RUN
  levels and the Horde run phase; never endless).
- Fixed-position lines (never steers / held left / held right, full intake) are checked at the expected shop and at rank 10
  against a model of the boss (levelgen.bossOutcome); a line near or past the boss's win line costs the attempt score, a
  line that clears gets the 32-attempt budget and the side repair (mirroring pairs / triples, last gate first; each mirror
  re-simulates the declared line before it is validated, and a rejected mirror restores it).
- Shop-surplus compensation (D26, LEAK_MODEL.surplusExp 1.0): in the campaign, wave / guard / run-up / minion HP scale with
  util.shopComp(p, pExp(L), profileExp(L), 1.0) — p^profileExp up to the expected shop (data.expectedRanksOf: the tester
  ranks to L30, rank 10 after), and the surplus above it answered in full. Upgrades past the expected shop still raise the
  start squad and the boss fight, but no longer weaken the waves. Nothing changes from L31 (the expected shop is rank 10).
- D31: a best attempt with validator errors gets the long budget; if a full-intake line is still above its limit, its richest
  lane loses one design grid step at a time (re-validated) until the script validates. 0 error scripts on L2–120 × 8 seeds,
  L6–8 × 24 seeds and L2–300 × 2 seeds (validate-levels --seeds).
- Generation is sliced (D39): levelgen.levelSteps / generateRunSteps yield after every modelled moment and validation stretch;
  a slice starts no step unless the predicted step — the larger of the last one and 0.3 × the job's largest (SLICE_JOB_SHARE)
  — plus 1.5 ms still fits its 8 ms. Measured: 53 ms per level on desktop; at 4× CPU slice p95 7.2 ms (RUN L2–60, 81 slices a
  level, +8 % over the plain last-step rule's 7.9 ms) and 7.7 ms (Horde run phases). A share of 0.5 gave 6.5 / 7.2 ms for +34 %
  slices (a longer cold-start spinner), 0 gave 7.9 / ≈ 8.1 ms (build/P1/gen/fr1).

FAIL-STREAK ASSIST ("REINFORCEMENTS") — only for a player who played (D30 as amended by A1)
- Replace "after 2 consecutive failures" with: after 2 consecutive COUNTED failures. A failed run counts only with ≥ max(3,
  minShare·gate events reached) counted gate decisions (LEVELS.curve.assist; minShare 0 until P1M measures it). A gate decision
  is counted at most once per gate event, at its commit, when the steering target travelled ≥ 2 m or changed lane while that
  event was the active one. A run left alone counts nothing and neither adds to nor resets the streak; a single swipe counts
  one decision at most. level.activity { decisions, eventsReached } holds the run's counts (later level types add theirs with
  level.addActivity). RETRY still plays a fresh road after every failure.
- Measured (build/P1/activity): idle and held lines 0 decisions; a one-swipe line exactly 1; the decent / skilled bots 3–7 of
  7–14 events (counted on 11 of 12 runs each); the decent bot at shop rank 0 on L20 failed twice (counted) and started its
  third attempt with +48 soldiers; idle and one-swipe sequences never got the assist.
- Open for P1M before release (verifier r1; cause corrected in fix round 2): the counter credits only 1–7 of a decent
  player's 7–14 gate events (strongj / human on L7, L10, L20: 50 / 55 of 120). The commit→pass stretch is not the cause:
  gates.activeEvent stays on an event until it passes at z ≥ 0, 4 m after its commit at WORLD.gateCommitZ, and the steering
  target moved 0.0 m in that stretch on all 24 probe runs. Every uncounted event is one where the target stayed in the lane
  nearest it at the event's activation and travelled < 2 m (135 of 135; median 1.1–1.2 m). Two kinds (build/P1/activity/
  actcause-fr2*): (1) SINGLE gate events — one gate across the whole road, no choice to make — are 28 of the 120 events and
  count 0; they still add to eventsReached; (2) pairs where the pick is the side the target already leans to: the harness bots
  steer only toward the active event and drift back to the road centre (± their jitter) while no event is live, so a pick on
  the near side is reached in < 2 m (42 of 92 pairs uncounted for strongj, 37 of 92 for human). A beginner who fails early on
  a short level (3–4 events reached) can stay under minDecisions 3, get no REINFORCEMENTS and be told "STEER TO PICK YOUR
  GATES" (P7) although they steered (strongj L7 seed 1307 counted 1 of 7; that run cleared, a failed one like it would not
  count). The counting matches A1 as written. P1M measures the counted share of FAILED runs for strongj and human (A1 pass: ≥ 90 %) and, only if needed, changes values
  (minDecisions / minShare / minTravelM); a minShare > 0 should be measured against multi-lane events only, since singles
  can never be decisions.

THE HORDE RUN PHASE (generator side; PLAN §B / D28)
- levelgen.generateRunSteps(L, seed, opts) builds the run before a hold on runCurve(L, opts): gates events on 140 + 100·(gates − 1)
  m, a 5-zombie run-up, the design line ending at E_hold (eEnd); fixed lines ≤ 0.80·E_hold at the expected shop and rank 10, a
  line ≥ 0.84·E_hold gets the long budget and the side repair. Model, 12 Horde levels × 8 seeds: 0 invalid, expected-shop
  lines ≤ 0.82·E_hold on 95 of 96 and ≤ 0.86 on 96 of 96.

Validator status: `node tools/validate-levels.js` reports 0 errors (warnings are fixed-line and leak-band notes); the summary
prints the error-script count and the teaching ladder's rules.
